supporting_pages.title: "Call REST Endpoint task \_|\_ Application Integration \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Before you begin To connect to an authentication endpoint for the REST API call, ensure that you have either created an OAuth 2.0 profile or attached a user-managed service account to your integration.
Note: If you update the authentication profile for a Call REST Endpoint task, and test the integration without publishing the changes, the integration uses the old authentication profile.
Hence, the task can't connect to hosts or IPs that reside only within a private network such as a VPC, even if that VPC is peered with your other Google Cloud services such as Apigee X.
